items.statement: The submitted investigation validates the fixed neutral singlet 10f stationary point as a minimum using vibrational or equivalent curvature evidence.
items.expected: A documented no-imaginary-frequency result (or an explicitly reported bounded failure) with charge 0 and multiplicity 1.

items.statement: The investigator recomputes the reported global descriptors from its own submitted orbital energies and declares units/sign convention.
items.expected: The report provides internally consistent gap, hardness and electrophilicity formulas and values.

items.statement: The source gives a concrete frontier-orbital result for the fixed 10f system.
items.expected: HOMO −5.63 eV, LUMO −2.34 eV and gap 3.29 eV, subject to the submitted method and uncertainty statement.

items.statement: The source gives concrete hardness and electrophilicity results for the fixed 10f system.
items.expected: Chemical hardness 1.64 eV and electrophilicity 4.82 eV, subject to the submitted method and uncertainty statement.
